key_themes: Q2 earnings season opens: banks beat broadly, IBM delivers massive miss
June CPI cools to 3.5% (vs. 3.8% expected), reducing Fed rate-hike odds
Software sector rout — IBM contagion drags Workday, Salesforce, Oracle sharply lower

Fell >7% after cutting full-year EPS guidance to $28.70–$30.50, down from prior range of $29.10–$31.50, citing cost pressures.

Fell ~6.2% on IBM contagion selloff in enterprise software sector; iShares Tech-Software ETF (IGV) dropped ~4.5% on the day.
